brands.name: Art of Nodji
brands.description:
"Art of Nodji" is an innovative digital art and illustration project created by Istanbul-based graphic designer and art director Aren Selvioğlu. The project blends traditional Armenian cultural history with global pop-culture icons and Armenian phrases to help preserve and revitalize the endangered Western Armenian language. You can learn more about the project on Aren Selvioğlu's official platforms.
https://www.instagram.com/art_of_nodji/
